title: Detailed crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="moonGrad" cx="40%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9C4"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFE082"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB300"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer soft glow of the moon -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="50" r="38" fill="#FFD54F" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="50" r="32" fill="#FFE082" opacity="0.15"/>

  <!-- Crescent moon body: large circle minus offset circle -->
  <path d="M50,12
           A38,38 0 1,0 50,88
           A30,30 0 1,1 50,12 Z"
        fill="url(#moonGrad)" filter="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Crescent inner edge highlight -->
  <path d="M50,12
           A38,38 0 1,0 50,88
           A28,28 0 1,1 50,12 Z"
        fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Moon craters / surface details -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="30" r="5" fill="#E6A700" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="30" r="3" fill="#D49A00" opacity="0.35"/>

  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="4" fill="#E6A700" opacity="0.45"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="2" fill="#C88B00" opacity="0.3"/>

  <circle cx="28" cy="66" r="3.5" fill="#E6A700" opacity="0.4"/>

  <circle cx="42" cy="72" r="3" fill="#E6A700" opacity="0.45"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="72" r="1.8" fill="#C88B00" opacity="0.3"/>

  <circle cx="36" cy="42" r="2" fill="#D49A00" opacity="0.35"/>

  <circle cx="26" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#E6A700" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Tiny crater dots -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#C88B00" opacity="0.3"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="26" r="1.2" fill="#C88B00" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="44" r="1" fill="#C88B00" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Subtle ridge lines on the moon surface -->
  <path d="M34,34 Q38,38 36,44" stroke="#D49A00" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.25"/>
  <path d="M28,56 Q32,60 30,64" stroke="#D49A00" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none" opacity="0.2"/>
  <path d="M44,22 Q46,28 43,32" stroke="#D49A00" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none" opacity="0.2"/>

  <!-- Small stars scattered nearby -->
  <path d="M82,20 L83.2,23.5 L87,24 L84.2,26.5 L85,30 L82,28 L79,30 L79.8,26.5 L77,24 L80.8,23.5 Z"
        fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M15,18 L15.8,20.5 L18.5,21 L16.5,22.8 L17,25.5 L15,24 L13,25.5 L13.5,22.8 L11.5,21 L14.2,20.5 Z"
        fill="#FFE082" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M88,68 L88.8,70.5 L91.5,71 L89.5,72.8 L90,75.5 L88,74 L86,75.5 L86.5,72.8 L84.5,71 L87.2,70.5 Z"
        fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="80" r="1.5" fill="#FFE082" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="78" r="1" fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="42" r="1.2" fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
